title: Past 50 Staff Without a Payroll Team

slides.heading: Past 50 Staff: Who Runs Your Payroll?
slides.body: Use the milestone to check responsibilities—not assume something will break.

slides.heading: Who Is Responsible for Running Payroll?
slides.body: Without an in-house payroll team, can you name the person responsible for every payroll run?

slides.heading: Who Handles Each New Employee?
slides.body: When someone joins, is responsibility for employee onboarding clearly assigned?

slides.heading: What Else Are Those People Handling?
slides.body: Are payroll and employee onboarding sitting alongside someone’s main role? Check whether those responsibilities have dedicated capacity.

slides.heading: Could Your Current Setup Handle More Staff?
slides.body: Before another round of hiring, ask whether you want to keep these responsibilities inside the business.

slides.heading: For Growing Egyptian and Saudi Companies
slides.body: Qimam People serves companies with 30–300 staff that do not have an in-house payroll team.

slides.heading: Give Payroll and Onboarding an External Desk
slides.body: Qimam People is an outsourced HR operations desk in Cairo that runs payroll and employee onboarding.
